title: PaperBanana-Interact: Scientific Diagram Refinement with Multi-Turn Human Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2608.30241v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent efforts have aimed to automate scientific diagram generation from paper content (Lin et al., 2026; Zhu et al., 2026a). However, fully satisfying an author's visual and communicative preferences in a single turn is challenging: in our formative user study (N = 14), all participants requested further revisions after viewing an initial draft, and 86% of them rated the refined diagrams as more satisfactory. Despite the clear demand, the multi-turn workflow remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we present MTPaperBananaBench, a benchmark for multi-turn diagram generation containing 292 images annotated with 3,518 user requirements. To reduce expensive human studies and enable scalable benchmarking, we construct a user simulator that, at each turn, identifies unsatisfied requirements and converts k of them into natural language feedback. translated_title: PaperBanana-Interact：基于多轮人类反馈的科学图表精修
translated_abstract: 近期的研究致力于根据论文内容自动生成科学图表。然而，在单轮交互中完全满足作者的视觉与传达偏好是具有挑战性的：在我们的形成性用户研究（N = 14）中，所有参与者在查看初稿后都要求进一步修改，其中86%的人认为修改后的图表更令人满意。尽管需求明确，多轮工作流程在很大程度上仍未被充分探索。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了MTPaperBananaBench，一个多轮图表生成基准，包含292张图像，并标注了3,518条用户需求。为减少昂贵的人类研究并实现可扩展的基准测试，我们构建了一个用户模拟器，它在每一轮中识别未满足的需求，并将其中k个转换为自然语言反馈。对需求满足度和整体图表质量的评估揭示了两个关键失败……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个多轮科学图表生成基准MTPaperBananaBench（含292张图像和3,518条标注用户需求），并构建用户模拟器将未满足的需求转化为自然语言反馈，从而实现对基于人类反馈的多轮图表精修的可扩展评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MTPaperBananaBench, a multi-turn scientific diagram generation benchmark with 292 images and 3,518 annotated user requirements, and a user simulator that converts unsatisfied requirements into natural language feedback, enabling scalable evaluation of multi-turn human-in-the-loop diagram refinement.
